summary: Tested NOC Dashboard translations, mobile hamburger menu, and WebSocket status. Found critical translation bug: widget files in /app/frontend/src/components/noc/widgets/ have HARDCODED Spanish text instead of using t() translation function. Mobile hamburger menu works correctly. WebSocket endpoint returns 'running'.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded Spanish text 'Organizaciones' on line 24 instead of using t('noc.organizations', 'Organizations')
Hardcoded Spanish text 'Historial' on line 24 and 'Sin caídas (7d)' on line 37 instead of using t() function
Hardcoded Spanish text 'Alertas' on line 27 and 'Sin alertas (24h)' on line 40 instead of using t() function

passed_tests: Mobile menu shows navigation items - PASS (found: Devices, Statistics, Structure, Types, Alerts, etc.)
Mobile navigation clicks work - PASS (clicking Devices navigates to devices tab)
NOC Dashboard opens via floating button - PASS (data-testid='noc-floating-btn')
NOC Dashboard widgets display - PASS (Organizaciones, Historial, Alertas visible)
failed_tests: NOC widget titles translate when changing language - FAIL (hardcoded Spanish in widget files)

root_cause_analysis.issue: NOC widget titles showing Spanish instead of translating
root_cause_analysis.cause: The App.js imports NOCDashboardRefactored which uses modular widgets from /components/noc/widgets/. These widget files (OrganizationsWidget.jsx, HistoryWidget.jsx, AlertsWidget.jsx) have HARDCODED Spanish strings instead of using the t() translation function.
root_cause_analysis.note: The main NOCDashboard.jsx file (which is NOT being used) has the correct translations. The fix was applied to wrong file - should have been applied to the widget files that NOCDashboardRefactored imports.

action_items: FIX: Add useTranslation hook and use t() function in OrganizationsWidget.jsx, HistoryWidget.jsx, AlertsWidget.jsx
HistoryWidget.jsx line 37: Change 'Sin caídas (7d)' to {t('noc.noDowntime', 'No downtime (7d)')}
AlertsWidget.jsx line 40: Change 'Sin alertas (24h)' to {t('noc.noRecentAlerts', 'No alerts (24h)')}
